snippet.title: Abyss Veil Opening「2003」
snippet.description:
Anime opening of Abyss Veil has been found, 2003 restoration in 4k / 1080p



Abyss Veil is a anime-inspired, story-driven, newgrounds/deviant art, psychological horror FPS that retraces the lives of Ivy and Mel in a war torn world. Meet strange folks, fight like hell, unravel strange mysteries, and most importantly, enjoy your stay!

Play Now (40% off):
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3668430/Abyss_Veil/

note: This is my first game ever, and has mostly been a learning project to get the hang around what its like making a game by myself. What started as a fake game to showcase sound design in a portfolio turned into a whole game lol. So I figured itd be a waste to leave it as nothing but a fake game, and actually turn it into something. Learned how to use blender3d, godot, even how to draw bad neko sugar girls tier cgs. Honestly proud of me for finally finishing something in my life. Hope yall like the twisted & edgy story i wrote for this! 

#fps #horror #psychologicalhorror #indiegame #gaming #indiegames #visualnovel
